verdict.rationale: The Python SDK shows a sandbox created with a single `daytona.create()` call. Each sandbox gets a dedicated kernel, filesystem, network stack and allocated resources, and Daytona claims spin-up in milliseconds, with warm pools that hand out pre-created sandboxes instantly. TypeScript and Python SDKs plus a published OpenAPI spec make this programmatic. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the startup-time claims (all speed evidence is vendor marketing or docs).
